scripts.build: npm run build -w @floor/assembly-lines && npm run build -w @floor/store && npm run build -w @floor/station && npm run build -w @floor/lore-converter && npm run build -w @floor/github && npm run build -w @floor/api && npm run build -w @floor/cluster-agent
scripts.test: npm run test -w @floor/assembly-lines && npm run test -w @floor/store && npm run test -w @floor/station && npm run test -w @floor/lore-converter && npm run test -w @floor/github && npm run test -w @floor/api && npm run test -w @floor/cluster-agent
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @floor/assembly-lines && npm run typecheck -w @floor/store && npm run typecheck -w @floor/station && npm run typecheck -w @floor/lore-converter && npm run typecheck -w @floor/github && npm run typecheck -w @floor/api && npm run typecheck -w @floor/cluster-agent
scripts.db:up: docker start floor-postgres 2>/dev/null || docker run --name floor-postgres -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=floor -e POSTGRES_DB=floor -p 5433:5432 -d pgvector/pgvector:pg16
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build -w @floor/store && FLOOR_DATABASE_URL=${FLOOR_DATABASE_URL:-postgres://postgres:floor@localhost:5433/floor} npm run migrate -w @floor/store
